purpose: Improve sampling efficiency using a frozen learned proposal without changing any scientific target or prior.
initial_target: Current LCDM, no luminosity evolution, Dovekie, official Planck, CPU modern_fast, original cubic spectrum surrogate. Exact native importance correction remains mandatory.

proposal.meaning: 1.05 and 2 multiply marginal standard deviations; Student covariance equals df/(df-2) times its scale matrix.
proposal.training: Each frozen source chain is expanded with integer frequency weights. Discard first 50%; learn pooled population mean/covariance from the next 40%; final 10% is withheld from learning.
proposal.support: Positive density over all real sampled coordinates. No truncation, clipping or proposal redraw after a target rejection. Periodic parameters unsupported.
proposal.other_targets: A separately frozen same-dimensional target-specific source snapshot may be supplied. Sampling efficiency beyond LCDM has not been established.

sampling.implementation: Subclass installed Cobaya MCMC proposal transition only; retain inherited collection and convergence equations. Prior and likelihood implementations remain frozen.
sampling.streams: NumPy SeedSequence(root_seed).spawn(4), one independent child per MPI rank; independent from all proposal-training and pilot streams.
sampling.initialization: Independent proposal draws until inside the declared prior bounds; this affects only starting points. The original target evaluates the selected start. Initial transient and 10d accepted burn-in discarded exactly as in baseline.
sampling.rejections: All post-burn target rejections increment current-state frequency weight. Candidate ledger records every trial, both target/proposal densities, proposal component and decision. Normal stopping occurs on an accepted transition, leaving only the terminal new weight-one state outside the standard Cobaya completed-hold collection.
sampling.resumption: Initial implementation refuses resumption or overwriting. Interrupted attempts retain ledger and incomplete output; fresh independent runs require a new folder and declared seed.

numerical_initialization.function: camb.get_results before any sampled density, no random draws
numerical_initialization.theory_settings: frozen modern native extra_args with lmax at least9001, matching actualmodern spectrum request
numerical_initialization.reason: Observed one-time cold/warm rdrag shift; three distinct native controls left subsequentfixed-point stateidentical. Preserve cold failure; no physical priorchange.

convergence.original_Cobaya_multivariate_Rminus1: strictly below 0.005 at two successive original checks
convergence.original_Cobaya_bound_Rminus1: strictly below 0.05 at original 95% bound level
convergence.additional_rank_Rhat: at most 1.01 for every sampled and existing diagnostic parameter
convergence.additional_segments: Identical to diagnostics.py: expand frequency weights, discard 30% after sampler burn-in, use common terminal length from all four independent chains.
convergence.checkpoint: Only report converged after original and additional requirements pass. Never relax thresholds or transform a max-samples stop into convergence.

validation.density_and_balance: Compare normalized mixture against independent SciPy densities and direct detailed balance.
validation.known_target: Four-chain synthetic Gaussian run with actual inherited Cobaya convergence checks; inspect distribution, rejection weights, candidate ledger and output contract.
validation.negative_controls: Shifted chain, concentrated weights, insufficient ESS, target/proposal identity tampering, forbidden adaptation/temperature/backend configuration rejected.
validation.backend_closure: The originally declared eight-point cold closure failed and is preserved. Same-order400point NumPy repeat had identicallikelihoods/decisions. New one-native-initialization contract must match all eight fixedwarm pilot points in forward/reverse orders within original1e-8 tolerance.
validation.production: No launch before root review; new production chains must pass unchanged diagnostics and native correction before scientific summaries.
